SddModule.keywords: module, authoring, decomposition, entity, dbc, sdd-new, sdd-check
SddModule.Mission: Materialize the smallest cohesive module hierarchy from an actual scope draft. The autonomous route is skeleton → orient → one whole-document Write → soft check → handoff. Tasks belong to scaffold; dialogue ceremony belongs to the optional interactive profile.
SddModule.BeliefState:
Inherited from the loading directive (already in context): AX_TOOL_INVOCATION
Decision first, reasoning on demand. The must-read top of a message is short: where we are + my read + what to decide. Everything heavy — full option comparison, evidence, the change-list, derivations — goes BELOW a `### ↓ Детали — по желанию` header. Never dump reasoning above the questions. Facts already verified collapse to one line («сверился: …»); uncertainties that need the operator BECOME the questions — never list them twice.
In `refine-module` mode existing public surface is preserved unless explicitly retired with operator approval.
Refinement = adding entities, tightening contracts (preconditions can become stricter, postconditions cannot become weaker), or fixing wrong details. Removing a public entity or weakening postconditions is a breaking change requiring a Decision Log entry with operator-confirmed `Risk accepted`.
A breaking change additionally emits a Pivot Invalidation List (`PIVOT_INVALIDATION_LIST_FORMAT`) in this module's spec: its consumer modules — the siblings whose `Inter-Module Dependencies` declares an edge `--> this-module` — listed as `refine-module` targets, plus their tasks to reopen. Consumers are derived from the reverse edges of the module graph; audit verifies every listed item is addressed via `AX_STALE_AFTER_PIVOT_VERIFICATION`. Symmetric to a scope `pivot` — a breaking module change does not close while a consumer is left silently stale.
Refinement preserves the Entity Inventory closed-world commitment: post-refinement inventory is still complete. New entities go into the inventory in the same authoring change.
Module spec body is reworked in place where needed; full predecessor state lives in git history.
Before writing any operator-facing artifact, recall the language rules — `AX_OPERATOR_DIALOGUE_STYLE` (bureaucratic noun-for-verb phrasing, literal calque, bookish word) and `AX_READER_WITHOUT_SESSION_CONTEXT` (a branch name, «как обсуждали», a session-plan label) — and hold the text about to be written to them. This is the author's own pass, done in the moment of writing, not a report to the operator. The independent post-check (lint, audit) stays separate and unchanged — this pass does not replace it.

Contracts.Contract:
A disputed autonomous decision is one durable line carrying what, why, and where. Record it once in the artifact owner that a fresh agent already reads; never create a deviation sidecar or copy the same fact into both logs.
- Spec authoring or architecture: append one canonical Decision Log entry: `-DL-N — ; где: (почему: )`. - Task decomposition: append that same Decision Log grammar to the narrowest owning task index. - Phase execution: put ` ← @ ` in the current phase Handoff `deviations: [...]` field; `sdd-log complete` persists that Handoff line in the Execution Log.
Obvious/recoverable mechanics are not deviations. Record only a choice a fresh agent could not re-derive from artifacts. Uncertainty does not pause an autonomous batch: record the smallest safe choice and continue. Operator review happens once, after the whole batch and its audits.

Step.Action: Resolve initial/add/refine from disk once. For each new cohesive module, call the ToolCall before reading optional formats. A function/fix scope creates one Function/Service module without invented Port or parallel owner. npx gennady sdd-new module --scope --module Inputs , : scope and cohesive module name resolved in this step. Use moduleManifest.

npx gennady sdd-orient --scope Inputs : scope resolved in STEP_0_CREATE. Use orientation. `sdd-orient` is the only unconditional foreign-context read. Do not load interview, research, or registry protocols unless orientation exposes a real ambiguity.

Step.Goal: Generate and write the complete module specification once.
Step.Action: Read the on-disk skeleton once and compose the COMPLETE module document in memory. Before writing, run the self-check pass per `AX_ARTIFACT_STYLE_SELF_CHECK`. Replace the skeleton with exactly ONE `Write` of the whole file. `Edit`, `Patch`, and per-section writes are forbidden in authoring. Retain every SECTION marker and replace every `` guidance comment with authored content; none may survive the Write. Keep a closed inventory, one owner for shared files/errors, public surfaces, per-operation DbC, file structure, and negative behavior. Read entity-inventory, entity-surface, and DbC formats only from the comments inside their owning sections, at the moment each section is filled. Remove every instructional comment. The scope owns its requirement IDs. With no narrower obligation write `No module-specific requirements. Implements parent requirements: .` A disputed autonomous boundary choice is one module Decision Log line per `DEVIATION_RECORD_FORMAT`; a zero-new-information decision continues without a dialogue stop. Per `AX_REFINE_MODULE_PRESERVES_CONTRACTS`, removing a public entity or weakening a postcondition is a breaking change: it needs a Decision Log entry with operator-confirmed `Risk accepted` plus a Pivot Invalidation List naming every consumer module (the siblings whose Inter-Module Dependencies edge points at this one) as a `refine-module` target — `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/pivot-formats.xml")` for the list format.

Step.Goal: Make the scope Module Map match actual module files.
Step.Action: Validate that the scope's already generated whole document names the exact relative module links and dependency direction. Do not patch its Module Map here: the scope writer owns that map, and authoring never creates a second sectional writer.

npx gennady sdd-check --spec --authoring Inputs : exact path from moduleManifest. Use moduleReceipt. The receipt auto-fixes trivial format. If a content hint remains, report authoring incomplete; never switch to sectional Edit/Patch repair. Rerun once only after checker auto-fix for the final receipt. For scale=function|fix, check the scope and its one module in this same pass and treat both receipts as one manifest result.

ExecutionPlan.ScalePath: One Function/Service module without invented Port/Adapter; one authoring pass, one combined manifest, no repeated boundary discussion.

Step.Action: Only after the final moduleReceipt has no hints, close authoring atomically. npx gennady sdd-log <module-spec-path> authoring-complete Inputs <module-spec-path>: exact checked path from STEP_4_CHECK. Use moduleAuthoringReceipt.

If an operator explicitly requested live interaction, lazily `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/authoring-interactive.directive.xml")`. Otherwise record deviations and continue to the mechanical close/scaffold route.
